item.title: Takachiho's Sacred Caves — Guide
item.description: The Takachiho area is home to sacred caves at the very heart of Japan’s foundational creation mythology, making them among the most spiritually charged natural sites in the country. The most famous is linked to the legend of Amaterasu, the sun goddess, who — angered by her brother — hid herself in a heavenly rock cave (Ama-no-Iwato), plunging the world into darkness until the other gods gathered to lure her out.
